From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Protected area in Austria

The Blockheide is an exposed outcrop and protected area near Gmünd in northwestern Waldviertel in the Austrian state of Lower Austria.[1]

It is known for large, exposed granite blocks, among them some Rocking stones.

The Blockheide-Eibenstein Nature Park (German: Naturpark Blockheide-Eibenstein) is the associated nature park.[2] It has a varied heather landscape including meadows, mixed woods including Scots pines, small lakes and small fields.
